scope: Published protected policy is the recommended cup route; two completed ACT experiments are separately retained supplements.

coverage.cup: Archived strict evaluation and existing complete training notebooks
coverage.robocasa: Historical 16x50 official policy comparison and latest single-task full training
coverage.dexjoco: Historical 11-task inference archive and latest single-task full training with separated deployment conditions
coverage.discoverse: Archived expert tasks and rendering; learned-policy aggregate not inferred from expert success
coverage.robowits: Published 100k training route and individual success video; full ten-task aggregate not verified
coverage.unitree: AMD proxy control audit and separately labeled reference-runtime free-base demonstration; complete current-device RL training unverified
coverage.acceleration: Bounded action-head inference exercises, static graph replay, native MuJoCo multi-step calls, and separately labeled historical AMD conditional-graph evidence.

recommended_cup_route.default_action: Read saved outputs and reuse released policy; training and full evaluation are opt-in
